rows.note: Use 互補 as the all-purpose choice when two things fit together or complete each other, including technical base pairing.

example.english: These two colours are complementary and look great together.
example.traditional: 呢兩種顏色互補，襯埋一齊好靚。
example.jyutping: ne1 loeng5 zung2 ngaan4 sik1 wu6 bou2 can3 maai4 jat1 cai4 hou2 leng3

rows.note: Use 補充 before a noun when complementary means extra supporting material, such as notes or information.

example.english: The teacher handed out complementary notes to help us study.
example.traditional: 老師派咗份補充資料，方便我哋溫書。
example.jyutping: lou5 si1 paai3 zo2 fan6 bou2 cung1 zi1 liu2 fong1 bin6 ngo5 dei6 wan1 syu1
